app.name: Tekken: Dark Resurrection Wii
app.author: Tekken Wii port contributors
app.short_description: Native static-recompilation port of Tekken: Dark Resurrection (PSP).
app.long_description: Unofficial, non-commercial fan project. Experimental Wii port of the PSP Tekken: Dark Resurrection executable using the tkdr-recomp runtime. Requires your own ULUS10139 EBOOT and ISO. No game data is included. Game data may live on SD or a FAT/read-only NTFS USB stick. Credits and licences: see CREDITS.md, THIRD_PARTY.md and LICENSE in the source repository.
